command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
p='worktree_merge_test.go'
s=open(p).read()

# In TestMergeThreeWayNoConflict, add tree check after parents
old='''\tcommit, err := r.CommitObject(head.Hash())
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, 2, len(commit.ParentHashes))

\tours, err := util.ReadFile(w.Filesystem, "ours.txt")'''
new='''\tcommit, err := r.CommitObject(head.Hash())
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, 2, len(commit.ParentHashes))
\tassert.Equal(t, featureRef.Hash(), commit.ParentHashes[1])

\tours, err := util.ReadFile(w.Filesystem, "ours.txt")'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)

# In TestMergeNonConflictingFilesWithConflict, assert index stage 0 for non-conflicting files
old2='''\t// Non-conflicting files are merged into worktree
\ttheirs, err := util.ReadFile(w.Filesystem, "theirs.txt")
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, "theirs\\n", string(theirs))
\tours, err := util.ReadFile(w.Filesystem, "ours.txt")
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, "ours\\n", string(ours))'''
new2='''\t// Non-conflicting files are merged into worktree
\ttheirs, err := util.ReadFile(w.Filesystem, "theirs.txt")
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, "theirs\\n", string(theirs))
\tours, err := util.ReadFile(w.Filesystem, "ours.txt")
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, "ours\\n", string(ours))

\t// and staged as single stage-0 entries
\tidx, err := r.Storer.Index()
\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tfor _, name := range []string{"theirs.txt", "ours.txt"} {
\t\tcount := 0
\t\tfor _, e := range idx.Entries {
\t\t\tif e.Name == name {
\t\t\t\tcount++
\t\t\t\tassert.Equal(t, index.Stage(0), e.Stage)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t\tassert.Equal(t, 1, count)
\t}'''
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w worktree_merge_test.go && go test . -run 'TestMerge' -count=1 2>&1 | tail -20
